# Darnell Pools (concept page by Kerblabs)

> Custom pools and outdoor living in Austin and Dallas, Texas, run by father-daughter team Bill and Lexi Darnell. Details from darnellpools.com.

## Services
- Custom pool construction
- Pool remodeling and restoration
- Outdoor living and landscapes
- BBQ islands and kitchens
- Custom patio covers
- Fire pits and lounge areas
- Hardscapes and landscaping
